act: I told my sister I would let her stay, but that I would tell my partner before bringing her back in. I then told my partner before inviting her inside.
why: I couldn’t promise my partner a private evening and secretly give it away. I also couldn’t ask my sister to leave without knowing where she would go.
aftermath: Later that night, my sister told me she had missed the last bus. The argument with Mum was still not explained. I had let her stay that night; we did not settle a new rule about the key.
deliberatelyWithheld: The medical reason, partner’s response, mother’s behavior, exact argument and long-term key arrangement are withheld. Missing the last bus is later testimony, not evidence known at the threshold.

finalPlayerPoseByOption.invite_now: Hero facing sister at inside threshold, phone held, doorway unchanged.
finalPlayerPoseByOption.ask_first: Hero speaking toward sister, no beckoning or doorway closing.
finalPlayerPoseByOption.decline_help: Hero facing sister, phone retained; sister stays at original mark.

choreography.heldVisualTrace: Hold the door jamb with the sister still outside and my phone in hand; the chair can remain a small secondary trace. The jamb becomes the margin of the first-person author text. No invitation crossing is animated.
choreography.camera: Stop following; keep selected final relation/prop frame. Cut to paper if reduced motion; no orbit or NPC reaction insert.
choreography.sound: Neutral bed fades under editorial transition, not as a factual silence. No applause, gasp, music sting, synthetic author voice or replayed quote.
choreography.transition: Carry motif into warm paper margin. Persistent fictional label; bridge: “That is where your version stops. Here is what I did.”
choreography.firstAuthorLine: I told my sister I would let her stay, but that I would tell my partner before bringing her back in
choreography.actEntry: Automatic after enactment receipt or visual skip, then hold/bridge; never require another choice.
choreography.whyEntry: Reader Continue / scroll; no timed disclosure.
choreography.aftermathEntry: Reader Continue / scroll after why. Missing fields would be absent, never synthesized.
choreography.socialAvailable: Only after aftermath is presented, or reader explicitly chooses Skip the rest of the account. Skipping is logged as skipped, not read.
choreography.continuation: Primary: Open another fictional story. Secondary: I have a related story (private unsent draft only). No public counts or fake replies.
choreography.failure: Keep accepted act; Retry author account / exit. No re-commit, substitute outcome or wrong-option inference.

mappingNote: No forced authorOption: the author made a conditional agreement plus partner disclosure, not the offered immediate invitation. Present account without declaring match or mismatch.
